sources.entry: Warracker - Warranty tracker that lets you monitor expiry dates, upload receipts/files, and get alerts before warranties expire. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Warracker is a self-hosted, web-based warranty tracker that records product warranties, expiry dates, receipts and documents, and sends expiration alerts.
summary.what_it_does: Warracker is a web application for organizing product warranties. Users add warranties with purchase date, duration (or lifetime), serial numbers, price, vendor, tags, notes and photos, and can upload receipts and manuals. It sends expiration notifications by email or through Apprise-supported push services, with each threshold notifying once. The app supports multiple user accounts with admin controls and role-based access, including a global warranty view. It also tracks warranty claims with statuses and resolutions, offers a status dashboard with charts and totals, and supports CSV import and export of warranty data. Optional integrations include OIDC single sign-on and Paperless-ngx for document storage.
use_cases: Store receipts and invoices for purchases
Get reminders before a warranty runs out
Manage warranty claims for household appliances
Share warranty records across a team or family
Import or export warranty lists as CSV
how_to_run: Copy the compose file and .env example from the Docker/ folder
Fill in required values in .env (database credentials, SECRET_KEY, etc.)
Open the app in your browser and create the first account, which becomes the admin
notable: Alerts notify once per threshold rather than repeating daily, via email or Apprise (100+ push services named)
Warranty claim tracking with statuses, dates and resolutions
Full CSV round-trip of fields including notes, currency, model number and warranty type
Localized UI in 20 languages with RTL support
Optional OIDC SSO and Paperless-ngx document integration
caveats: README describes the project as in active development; advanced enhancements are still in progress and calendar integration is unchecked on the roadmap
Requires Docker and Docker Compose and a PostgreSQL database; setup needs a configured .env file
Detailed setup, configuration, and update guides are located in the external Warracker Wiki rather than the README
